responsibility: Declares tree-aware logical_location subclasses used by GCC diagnostics and SARIF emission. It defines the abstract compiler_logical_location helper plus concrete wrappers for a specific tree decl or for current_function_decl, exposing naming and kind queries that map GCC declarations onto logical-location metadata.
same_name_distinction: Declares the tree-specific logical_location class hierarchy used by diagnostics/SARIF emission. Unlike gcc/tree-logical-location.cc, it defines the abstractions and virtual interface wrappers, not the tree-to-name translation logic.
